preserving.description: Uses cat for the backup and a single awk pass writing to a temp file that replaces nginx.conf.

files.solve.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cat nginx.conf > nginx.conf.orig
awk '{ sub(/worker_connections 1024;/, "worker_connections 4096;"); sub(/keepalive_timeout 65;/, "keepalive_timeout 30;"); print }' nginx.conf.orig > nginx.conf.tmp
mv nginx.conf.tmp nginx.conf

preserving.description: Uses the /bin/bash shebang and a pure bash read loop that counts words without wc.

files.solve.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p bin
cat > bin/wordcount <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
count=0
while read -r -a words || [ "${#words[@]}" -gt 0 ]; do
  count=$((count + ${#words[@]}))
  words=()
done < "$1"
echo "$count"
EOF
chmod +x bin/wordcount
